review.why: Sets up and audits analytics: tracking plans, event names, GA4, tag manager and UTMs, with rules for computing rates over matching windows.
review.summary: Starts from the decisions the data should inform, then gives a tracking plan format, object-action event names, standard properties, GA4 and tag manager basics, UTM conventions including partner patterns and an AI-assistant channel, a validation checklist and privacy notes. Principles insist on computing totals by script, cross-checking them and matching observation windows.
strengths: Compute, don't eyeball: totals come from scripts and are cross-checked
UTM rules: lowercase, one spelling per source, no personal data
Partner-type UTM patterns with a matching GA4 channel group
cautions: Event library and GA4 and tag manager guides are in files not read here
Tool integration guides live outside the skill
Privacy section is brief: consent rules need legal advice
